caution_findings.evidence_context: Linked database rows use Corynebacterium stationis, Vibrio penaeicida, and/or Parastagonospora nodorum where primary Table 3 uses Brevibacterium stationis, Vibrio penaeicidae, and Septoria nodorum; matching MIC values remain recorded but the target-name differences are preserved as source_conflict.
Local XML/PDF/OA package and Table S1 do not provide a toxicity endpoint for these ALF peptides; final activity records are MIC-only.
